name: Commit
meaning: The exact commit the suites ran against.

name: Provider
meaning: The CI system that ran them.

name: Run reference
meaning: The provider's identity for the run and attempt.

name: Started at
meaning: When the run started.

name: Finished at
meaning: When the run finished.

name: Spec digest
meaning: The digest of the spec's data files at the commit, so the outcome list is tied to the test records it answers.

name: Attestation
meaning: Where the signed proof run is kept.

name: Test record
meaning: The ID of the test record in the spec.

name: Result
meaning: What the test did.

name: File
meaning: The file that ran it, from the product root.

name: Duration
meaning: How long it ran, in seconds.

name: Detail
meaning: Why it failed or was skipped, when it did not pass.

name: Commit
meaning: The commit judged.

name: Kind
meaning: Which gate.

name: Base commit
meaning: The base branch's head the change was judged against; none for a release.

name: Coverage
meaning: The coverage at the commit.

name: Base coverage
meaning: The coverage at the base commit; none for a release.

name: Proof run
meaning: The attestation of the proof run the verdict rests on.

name: Passed
meaning: Whether the commit passed the gate.

name: Reasons
meaning: Each reason for a refusal, one per line; empty when passed.
example:
ST-BLD-UC03-R01 fell from built
ST-GEN-INV05-T failed

name: Attestation
meaning: Where the signed verdict is kept; a release verdict always has one.

name: Module file digest
meaning: The digest of go.mod.

name: Sum file digest
meaning: The digest of go.sum.

name: Go version
meaning: The Go version go.mod states.

name: Source revision
meaning: The commit the cache serves.

name: Go SDK
meaning: The SDK that downloaded it.

name: Inventory digest
meaning: The digest of the cache's canonical record.

name: Module path
meaning: The module.

name: Version
meaning: Its version.

name: Zip hash
meaning: The hash go.sum states for its zip.

name: Source revision
meaning: The commit built.

name: Target
meaning: The entry point built, within the module.

name: Go SDK
meaning: The SDK that built it.

name: Module cache digest
meaning: The inventory of the module cache it built from.

name: Generation record digest
meaning: The digest of the service's .stego/state.yaml at that revision.

name: Executable digest
meaning: The digest of the executable it produced.

name: Record digest
meaning: The digest of the build record's canonical bytes.

name: Format
meaning: Its format.

name: Digest
meaning: The digest of the SBOM file.

name: Build record digest
meaning: The trusted build record the executable came from.

name: Executable digest
meaning: The executable it carries.

name: CA bundle digest
meaning: The explicit CA bundle it carries.

name: Entrypoint
meaning: The executable's name in the image.

name: Image digest
meaning: The OCI image's digest.

name: Signer
meaning: Who signed.

name: Transparency log entry
meaning: The signature's entry in the public transparency log.

name: Signed at
meaning: When it was signed.

name: Repository
meaning: The registry repository, without a tag.

name: Published at
meaning: When it was published.

name: Service name
meaning: The service the declaration describes.

name: Archetype
meaning: The curated component set the service is built from. Exactly one.

name: Language
meaning: The language the output is generated in.

name: Base path
meaning: The prefix every generated route sits under.

name: Error type base
meaning: The base address the generated error types are named from.

name: Entity name
meaning: The shape's name, unique in the declaration.

name: Field name
meaning: The field's name, unique in its entity.

name: Type
meaning: The kind of value the field holds.

name: Constraints
meaning: The limits the generated code checks, which must suit the type.

name: Default
meaning: The value used when the field is absent.

name: Collection name
meaning: The access pattern's name, unique in the declaration.

name: Entity name
meaning: The entity the collection reads, which the same declaration must declare.

name: Operations
meaning: What the collection allows. Each one generates its own handler and route.

name: Path prefix
meaning: The path the collection is served at, when it is not derived from the entity name and the scope.

name: Collection name
meaning: The collection the binding applies to. A binding names a collection, never an entity.

name: Slot
meaning: The extension point, which a component of the selected archetype must declare.

name: Operator
meaning: How the fills compose. Exactly one of gate, chain or fan-out.

name: Fills
meaning: The fills the operator composes, in order.

name: Component name
meaning: The component the setting is for, which must be in the active component set.

name: Setting name
meaning: The setting, which the component's schema must declare.

name: Value
meaning: The value, which must suit the type the component's schema states.

name: Component name
meaning: The component the service accepts, whose stage is not ga.

name: Accepted until
meaning: The date the acceptance runs out, which may not be later than the component's own sunset.

name: Reason
meaning: Why the service accepts it, so a reader can judge the risk.

name: Module path
meaning: The Go module path fills may import.

name: Reason
meaning: Why the fills need it, so a reviewer can judge it.

name: Component
meaning: The component's name.

name: Digest
meaning: The component digest whose standing this is.

name: Successor digest
meaning: The digest that replaces this one. The platform engineer declares it.

name: Fails after
meaning: The date after which a pin to the superseded digest fails.

name: Needs declaration change
meaning: Whether taking the successor needs a change to the service declaration.

name: Needs fill change
meaning: Whether taking the successor needs a change to a fill.

name: Recorded on
meaning: The date the platform engineer recorded the supersession.

name: Fails after
meaning: The date after which a pin to the withdrawn digest fails.

name: Reason
meaning: Why the digest is withdrawn, for the people who pin it.
example: The token check accepts an expired token.

name: Recorded on
meaning: The date the platform engineer recorded the withdrawal.

name: Source revision
meaning: The exact commit the release is built from.

name: Release tag
meaning: The tag of the published release.

name: Checks run
meaning: The CI run of the compiler checks at the source revision.

name: Signed artifact run
meaning: The CI run that built and signed the compiler at the source revision.

name: Immutable
meaning: Whether the published release can no longer change.

name: Compiler digest
meaning: The digest of the published compiler binary.

name: Workflow
meaning: The CI workflow the job ran in.

name: Job
meaning: The job's name.

name: Conclusion
meaning: How the job ended. Only success qualifies.

name: Name
meaning: The asset's name.

name: Size
meaning: The asset's size in bytes.

name: Digest
meaning: The digest the release publishes for the asset.

name: Result folder
meaning: The new folder that holds the installed compiler.

name: Source revision
meaning: The commit of the release that was installed.

name: Platform
meaning: The platform the release is qualified for, as its signed record states it.

name: Build identity
meaning: The build identity of the installed compiler.

name: Service name
meaning: The service the requirements belong to.

name: Schema version
meaning: The version of the requirements format.

name: Generation record digest
meaning: The digest of the generation record the file was written with.

name: Kind
meaning: What sort of thing it is.

name: Name
meaning: The name the service reads it by.

name: Shape
meaning: What a value must hold, such as a secret's keys or an endpoint's port.

name: Needed by
meaning: The component that needs it.

name: Provider
meaning: The CI system.

name: Pipeline
meaning: The platform's reusable workflow, or the Konflux standard pipeline bundle.

name: STEGO checks
meaning: The pinned bundle or action that runs every STEGO check.

name: Trusted signer
meaning: The one identity that may sign this pipeline's images.

name: Image targets
meaning: The images the pipeline builds, one per target; the delivery stanza declares them.

name: Service name
meaning: The service.

name: Image name
meaning: The image repository, with no tag or digest; the overlay sets the digest.

name: Resource defaults
meaning: The default CPU, memory and ephemeral storage requests and limits.

name: Tool
meaning: The GitOps tool; only argocd for now.

name: Project
meaning: The Argo CD project the delivery stanza names.

name: Base path
meaning: The path to the service's Kubernetes base.

name: Source revision
meaning: The commit built.

name: Image digest
meaning: The image's digest.

name: Build record digest
meaning: The stego build record the image's executable must match.

name: Provider
meaning: The CI system that built the image.

name: Check
meaning: One of drift, vet, test, build, executable match.

name: Passed
meaning: Whether the check passed.

name: Name
meaning: The fill's name, which is also its folder under fills/.

name: Implements
meaning: The one slot whose contract the fill implements.

name: Collection
meaning: The collection the fill serves.

name: Fill digest
meaning: The fill's content digest when its tests passed.

name: Contract digest
meaning: The digest of the slot contract the tests ran against.

name: Passed at
meaning: When the tests passed.

name: Compiler build
meaning: The compiler that ran the tests.

name: Evidence digest
meaning: The digest of the test evidence the signature covers.

name: Signature
meaning: The person's signature of that evidence.

name: Signed at
meaning: When the person signed.

name: Service name
meaning: The service the record describes. STEGO does not write it yet.

name: Format version
meaning: The version of the record's format. A documented field changes only with this version.

name: Declaration digest
meaning: The digest of the service declaration that apply read.

name: Registry reference
meaning: The registry reference from .stego/config.yaml.

name: Registry content digest
meaning: The digest of the registry content that apply read. A legacy record can leave it out.

name: Compiler build
meaning: The build identity of the compiler that ran the apply. A legacy record can leave it out.

name: Output folder
meaning: The folder, in the project, that holds the generated files.

name: Standing overrides
meaning: Each pin the author allowed although it was withdrawn or past its fail date, by component and digest, with the reason given.
example: outbox@sha256:4f1c…: fix 2.3.1 breaks our fill, moving next sprint

name: Component
meaning: The component's name.

name: Version
meaning: The component's version.

name: Digest
meaning: The digest of the component's own content. Today this column holds the registry reference, not a real per-component digest.

name: Path
meaning: The file's path in the output folder.

name: Hash
meaning: The digest of the content apply wrote.

name: Path
meaning: The file's path in the project.

name: Exists
meaning: Whether the file existed when apply read it.

name: Hash
meaning: The digest of the file's content, when it exists.

name: Mode
meaning: The file's permission bits, when it exists.

name: Output folder
meaning: The output folder the apply writes to.

name: Expected files
meaning: The state each file must have before the apply writes it.

name: Operations
meaning: Each file write in order, with the file's state before and after it.

name: Base record digest
meaning: The digest of the record the plan was made against. A plan for a service with no record leaves it out.

name: Declaration digest
meaning: The digest of the declaration that planning read.

name: Registry content digest
meaning: The digest of the registry content that planning read.

name: Compiler build
meaning: The build identity of the compiler that made the plan.

name: Output folder
meaning: The folder, in the project, that the plan writes to.

name: Planned files
meaning: Each file the plan would create, update or delete, with the hash of its new content.

name: Content digest
meaning: The digest of every input file of the active registry, which pins its content as a whole.

name: Path
meaning: The output path, from the generated project root.

name: Archetype name
meaning: The archetype's name, unique in its registry.

name: Version
meaning: The version the archetype declares.

name: Go SDK
meaning: The official Go SDK that every service of this archetype builds with.

name: Runtime library
meaning: The runtime library version every service of this archetype imports.

name: Component name
meaning: The component the archetype includes, by its name in the active registry.

name: Default for port
meaning: The port this component answers unless the declaration overrides it.

name: Mixin name
meaning: The mixin's name.

name: Port name
meaning: The port's name, unique in its registry.

name: Meaning
meaning: What a provider of this port undertakes to supply.
example: A verified identity for each request

name: Field name
meaning: The field a provider fills.

name: Required meaning
meaning: What every provider must put in the field.
example: The verified subject, which never changes

name: Slot name
meaning: The slot's name, unique in its component.

name: Component name
meaning: The component that declares the slot, by its name in the active registry.

name: Contract
meaning: The typed contract a fill implements, as a protobuf service.

name: Component name
meaning: The component's name, unique in the active registry.

name: Version
meaning: The version the component declares. It changes whenever the emitted code changes.

name: Stage
meaning: How far the component is on the maturity ladder.

name: Sunset
meaning: The date an alpha or beta component stops working. A ga component has none.

name: Config schema
meaning: Each setting a declaration may give the component, with its type, its allowed values, its default and whether it is optional.

name: Required ports
meaning: The ports the component needs another component to provide.

name: Provided ports
meaning: The ports the component provides.

name: Architecture role
meaning: Where the component sits in a service: its layer (edge, authentication, handler, slot, repository, store or outbound), the part it plays in a request flow, and which side of that flow each port it provides or requires is on. The architecture view places the component from this alone.
example: layer: edge; flow: receives the request and calls the handler port

name: Outcome served
meaning: The business outcome the component exists for, by its ID, stated when the component is requested and before its generator is written.

name: Minimum Go version
meaning: The lowest Go version the component's emitted code and pinned dependencies build with; the build target must meet it.

name: Location
meaning: Where the registry is: a pinned Git repository or a local folder.

name: Reference
meaning: The exact commit that pins the registry content.

name: Subfolder
meaning: The folder in the repository that holds the registry, when it is not the root.

name: Trust
meaning: Whether the source is the reviewed common registry or a local extension.

name: Component name
meaning: The component the evidence is for.

name: Component digest
meaning: The exact digest the evidence was made at.

name: Kind
meaning: Which part of the bar it shows.

name: Reviewer
meaning: Who made the review or ran the benchmark.

name: Result
meaning: What it found: the review's conclusion, or the benchmark's figures against the reference.
example: p99 latency within 5% of the reference

name: Reference
meaning: Where the full review or benchmark report is kept.

name: Recorded at
meaning: When the evidence was recorded.

name: Contract set digest
meaning: For a reference comparison, the digest of the component's output contracts it was made against; the comparison is stale once they change.

name: References
meaning: For a reference comparison, each best-in-field implementation compared with, by name and version; or none, with the reasoning why no reference exists.

name: Reference
meaning: The reference that makes the promise.

name: Promise
meaning: What the reference guarantees, in one sentence.
example: Every query is type-checked against the schema at generation time.

name: Verdict
meaning: adopted or declined.

name: Contract
meaning: The component's output contract that adopts it, when adopted.

name: Reason
meaning: Why it is declined, when declined.
example: Applies to a query language STEGO does not emit.
